shortlist_rationale: Activities are drawn only from the recommended cities (Phuket, Bangkok, Pattaya, Chiang Mai, Koh Samui), so the two lists stay coherent for itinerary planning. City ranking blends ambient fit (50%) with the strength of each city's own activity lineup for this persona (50%) — so an activity-rich city (e.g. Bangkok for a couple) can earn a place even if the location itself scores only mid on ambient qualities; see city_score_0_10 vs activity_strength_0_10 on each city. Shortlist sized to trip need, not catalogue size: activities kept within 1.5 pts of the top score (min 6.5/10) and capped at 15 for an unspecified duration (~3/day); cities capped at 5. Fewer are returned when fewer genuinely fit the persona.
